title: Castle Crush
description: Launch three stones per stage, topple timber and stone towers and defeat every guard across four stages.
controls: Drag back and down from the sling to aim, then release. Defeat every guard with three stones per stage.

zh-CN.title: 弹弓攻城
zh-CN.description: 拖动拉弓瞄准、松手投石，击倒木石城塔并清除全部守卫，每关三发，共四关。
zh-CN.controls: 从弹弓向后下方拖动瞄准，松手发射；每关只有三块石头，清除所有守卫过关。
